definitions.explanation: A professional who designs, builds, and maintains gardens, parks, and other outdoor spaces. In Japan, this requires specialized knowledge of plants, stone arrangement, and traditional garden aesthetics.

examples.japanese: {造園|ぞうえん}{士|し}に{庭|にわ}のデザインを{依頼|いらい}した。
examples.english: I asked a landscape gardener to design the garden.

examples.japanese: {造園|ぞうえん}{士|し}の{資格|しかく}を{取|と}るには{実務|じつむ}{経験|けいけん}が{必要|ひつよう}だ。
examples.english: Practical experience is needed to obtain a landscape gardener's qualification.

examples.japanese: {日本|にほん}{庭園|ていえん}を{手|て}がける{造園|ぞうえん}{士|し}は、{石|いし}の{配置|はいち}や{水|みず}の{流|なが}れにまで{細|こま}かく{気|き}を{配|くば}る。
examples.english: Landscape gardeners who work on Japanese gardens pay careful attention to details like stone placement and water flow.

notes:
A compound of {造園|ぞうえん} (landscape gardening, garden construction) and {士|し} (professional, specialist). Japan has a national certification system ({造園施工管理技士|ぞうえんせこうかんりぎし}) for landscape construction professionals.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {造園|ぞうえん}{士|し}の{資格|しかく}: landscape gardener qualification
- {造園|ぞうえん}{士|し}に{依頼|いらい}する: to hire a landscape gardener
- {一級|いっきゅう}{造園|ぞうえん}{施工|せこう}{管理|かんり}{技士|ぎし}: first-class landscape construction management engineer

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {庭師|にわし}: gardener — a traditional term for someone who tends and maintains gardens
- {植木屋|うえきや}: tree/shrub trimmer — focuses on planting and pruning trees
- {造園|ぞうえん}{業者|ぎょうしゃ}: landscaping contractor — a company rather than an individual
